description: A module singleton method that yields: Runner.twice { |x| x * 10 } : Int. Tier 8's callSMethod does not set Ctx.blockTy, and there is no rule for an explicit-receiver send with a block, so this fails for the same reason xc-class-block-param does -- one tier over. Worth having separately because the fix for a `.clsOf` receiver is not literally the fix for an `.inst` one.
